messages:
raj: FYI support ticket from MedSys — they got a compliance alert saying some requests were handled outside EU after a recent failover. ticket# 5542.
emma: Oh no. Do we have audit log sample + request ids?
raj: Pasting the audit snippet we pulled from router logs: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:05Z req=8f3a2c customer=medsys residency=eu policy_eval=strict failover_decision=forced_to_us-west-2 route=eu-west-1->us-west-2
2026-03-17T09:12:07Z req=8f3a2c serve_node=gw-usw2-4 region_served=us-west-2
```
olivia: Wait, policy_eval=strict but decision=forced_to_us-west-2? That shouldn't happen. Did the router fall back incorrectly? :thinking_face:
mike: The router has a short-circuit when pod capacity drops below 10% — older code path sets bypass_residency=true for 45s while it ramps. I thought we disabled that for customers with residency tags.
sre-bot: ALERT: failover-runner triggered cluster-level failover eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 at 2026-03-17T09:12:04Z due to node pressure. Soft-fallback enabled.
raj: Support says they saw an audit/compliance webhook triggered from their SIEM. They flagged it as P0. Customer wants: 1) why 2) audit trail 3) mitigation
emma: Can someone grep for the request ids and show the route decision trace? Also need the policy flags attached to medsys (org_id=medsys-prod).
mike: Repro steps I ran locally: 
1) spin up a small EU capacity pool (min=0)
2) hit it with steady load until the autoscaler kills spare GPUs
3) send a normal request with header `X-Residence: eu`
Result: router flips to us-west for ~30s and the response includes header `X-Served-From: us-west-2`
I'll attach the minimal curl:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Residence: eu" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -o /tmp/r
```
olivia: If the code path sets bypass_residency=true on the failover, that's the bug. We should never bypass for orgs with residency=eu and policy=strict.
support-bot: MedSys posted reproducible steps in the ticket: intermittent 502s, then audit webhook: 
- 2026-03-17T09:12:06Z audit.outbound -> region:us-west-2 req:8f3a2c
- They included request payload id and org tag.
raj: Action items: 1) rollback soft-fallback change on router (mike) 2) generate full audit trail for MedSys and send to customer (emma) 3) patch and add unit test to prevent bypass when residency=strict (olivia) 4) postmortem draft (me)
emma: I'll pull the full trace and S3 archive link and DM legal for incident notification scope.
mike: Rolling config rollback now (will patch subito). ETA ~12m.
olivia: I'll add a regression test to the routing policy evaluator and run CI.
sre-bot: CHANGE: router-config eu-west-1 updated by mike — rolling restart 3/6 nodes.
raj: Thanks. After rollback, confirm with 1) audit logs show served_from eu 2) MedSys sees no more cross-region events.
emma: Notifying customer in ticket with current mitigation steps and ETA. :white_check_mark:
raj: Assigning follow-ups: postmortem + SLA credit calc. tagging @olivia @mike for engineering fix.
support-bot: Customer acknowledged notification and paused escalation. "Thanks, please keep us posted." :thumbsup:
